extracted.intended_audience: researchers and institutions seeking Chan Zuckerberg Initiative (CZI) science grants (PIs, postdocs, research teams, nonprofit organizations, and imaging/software developers)
extracted.subtask_description: A listing of Chan Zuckerberg Initiative Requests for Applications (RFAs) describing the kinds of projects each program supports, cycles and funding amounts where provided, and links to RFA details—used by prospective applicants to find suitable grant opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advancing Technologies for Spatiotemporal Omics in Live Tissue
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports the development of real-time, minimally invasive technologies for proteomic and metabolomic profiling in live tissues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed in listing.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Implementation of Synthetic Biology Principles in Immunology
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports projects that apply synthetic biology to immune cell engineering, enabling programmable control of immune responses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed in listing.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Accelerating and Scaling Biological Sciences With AI
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA invites applications to build large-scale AI/ML models using compute power on CZI’s high-performance computing cluster to power new approaches to biological discovery.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Status: CLOSED / FULLY ALLOCATED AS OF 5/12/2025. RFA Details available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biohub Network — Global Science Scholars
rubrics_metrics.description: An up to two-year international postdoctoral fellowship program between the U.S. and Japan to advance excellence in bioengineering and biomedical research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed in listing.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Rare As One (Cycle 3)
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports patient-led nonprofit organizations as they launch collaborative research networks and work together to accelerate progress against rare diseases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cycle 3 - $24 Million. Also lists Cycle 1 - $13.5M and Cycle 2 - $13M across 'All grant resources'. RFA Details available.

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-Cell Biology Data Insights
rubrics_metrics.description: This grant program seeks to support computational experts to advance tools and resources that make it possible to gain greater insights into health and disease from single-cell biology datasets.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources - $14.9 Million. Cycle breakdown: Cycle 1 - $5.2M; Cycle 2 - $4.9M; Cycle 3 - $4.8M. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Essential Open Source Software for Science (Cycle 6)
rubrics_metrics.description: In partnership with The Kavli Foundation and The Wellcome Trust, this CZI program supports software maintenance, growth, development, and community engagement for critical open source scientific tools.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cycle 6 - $11.7 Million (with Kavli Foundation and Wellcome Trust). Historical cycle amounts shown (Cycle 1-6). RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Cryo-CLEM Labels
rubrics_metrics.description: This grant program aims to drive development of complete, general-purpose, intracellular imaging probes for cryo-correlative light and electron microscopy (cryo-CLEM).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $1.5 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Deep Tissue Imaging (Phases 1-2)
rubrics_metrics.description: This grant program aims to drive development of innovative imaging technologies that will advance the field of deep tissue imaging, allowing researchers to observe cells and subcellular processes at high resolution in complex tissue and through skin and bone.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Phase 1 - $13 Million; Phase 2 - $19.6 Million. All grant resources and RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative Pairs Pilot Project Awards (Cycle 2)
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports pairs of investigators and their teams to explore innovative, interdisciplinary approaches to address critical challenges in the fields of neurodegenerative diseases and fundamental neuroscience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cycle 2 - $12.8 Million. RFA details available. (Part of the Neurodegeneration Challenge Network; shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Measuring Metabolism Across Scales
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA aims to accelerate innovative discoveries in the field of metabolism and metabolic physiology in health and disease.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $8.6 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Ben Barres Early Career Acceleration Awards (Cycles 1-2)
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA aims to provide mentored support for early career investigators to conduct bold, innovative, and rigorous research in the basic science underlying neurodegenerative disease and fundamental neuroscience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cycle 1 - $42.5 Million; Cycle 2 - $15.6 Million shown under 'All grant resources'. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Advancing Imaging Through Collaborative Projects
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports new and existing collaborative projects to reduce imaging ecosystem fragmentation and accelerate the spread and adoption of technologies, methods, or training resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $5 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Dynamic Imaging
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA aims to advance technology directed at real-time visualization of biological processes at the level of cells and molecules.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $19.8 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: napari Plugin Grants
rubrics_metrics.description: This grant program will support software plugin development projects for the napari image analysis platform, a community-built, open source, and interactive tool for Python designed for browsing, annotating, and analyzing large multi-dimensional images.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cycle 1 - $1 Million; Cycle 2 - $875,000. Total/cycle amounts and RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-Partnered Single-Cell Analysis of Rare Pediatric Disease RFA
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA aims to support the application of single-cell biology methods to rare inflammatory pediatric diseases that will clarify cellular mechanisms of disease, understand disease heterogeneity, and improve biomarker identification or diagnostics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $10 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Patient-Partnered Rare Neurodegenerative Disease RFA
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA aims to advance the understanding of the pathophysiology and mechanistic underpinnings of rare neurodegenerative and neurological disorders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $10 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Chan Zuckerberg Biohub Network (scaling Biohub model)
rubrics_metrics.description: This funding opportunity supports scaling the Chan Zuckerberg Biohub model to pursue the toughest and most important scientific challenges by bringing together leading U.S.-based scientific and technology institutions within close geographical proximity to each other.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed in listing; descriptive text repeated in listing.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Expanding Global Access to Bioimaging
rubrics_metrics.description: This grant program supports imaging science capacity building, fellowships, and community development for imaging core facilities and nonprofit organizations in Africa, Latin America and the Caribbean, and former Soviet countries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $4.1 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Ancestry Networks for the Human Cell Atlas
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports researchers to contribute healthy, single-cell reference data from ancestrally diverse tissue samples to the Human Cell Atlas, with the aim of creating a more globally representative resource to understand disease.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $28 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Pediatric Networks for the Human Cell Atlas
rubrics_metrics.description: This grant program supports researchers to contribute pediatric tissue samples to the global Human Cell Atlas as a foundation for understanding how cells and organs progress and relate to disease onset in children.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $33 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Visual Proteomics Imaging
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports challenge grants in visual proteomics, with the goal of advancing technology that will enable researchers to view protein molecules and their interactions inside cells at near-atomic resolution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $27.5 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Imaging Scientists (Cycles 1-2)
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports CZI Imaging Scientists at imaging centers worldwide who will leverage biology, microscopy hardware, and imaging software to accelerate biomedicine and improve the imaging tools scientists use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All grant resources listed across cycles (e.g., $17.8M and $10.2M shown). RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Single-Cell Analysis of Inflammation
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports interdisciplinary scientists as they apply new tools and work together in accelerating inflammation research, aiming to further understanding of inflammation's role in health and disease.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $14 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Seed Networks for the Human Cell Atlas
rubrics_metrics.description: This RFA supports the continued development of the Human Cell Atlas, a global effort to map all cells in the human body.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $68 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative Science Awards (Neurodegeneration Challenge Network)
rubrics_metrics.description: As part of the CZI Neurodegeneration Challenge Network, these are grant opportunities for small-group interdisciplinary research collaborations that include a physician with active clinical engagement and address fundamental issues in neurodegenerative disease biology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $9 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaborative Computational Tools for a Human Cell Atlas
rubrics_metrics.description: This program awards grants to spur the creation of new computational tools, algorithms, visualizations, and benchmark datasets to analyze, interpret, and disseminate a large variety of molecular and imaging data generated for the global Human Cell Atlas.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $15 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Pilot Projects for a Human Cell Atlas
rubrics_metrics.description: This program awards scientific grants to support the Human Cell Atlas community’s convergence around standards, protocols, and best practices for the creation of a freely and openly available reference database of healthy human cells and tissues.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Total Grant Resources $15 Million. RFA Details available. (Shown as Closed.)
